comment: save.c/restore.c ubirthday witness: a January game recorded with tm_isdst=1 saves ubirthday as its local yyyymmddhhmmss string, and restgamestate() converts it back with mktime() under the restoring process's tm_isdst, an hour earlier. Reading the Hawaiian shirt after the restore shows a background that hawaiian_design() derives from the shifted ubirthday.
